# Process — What an Achieved Form Makes Possible Next

## #0 — An occurrence becomes an inheritance

A process account shows how a determination takes form and what its occurrence changes. Its product is available for another act: a memory bears upon an encounter, a rule constrains a decision, a response changes a relationship, and a tool alters the possible course of work. Taylor distinguishes [operative grammar, epistemic inspection and ontology](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A14-Computational-Process-Ontology.md): a repeatable operation, a judgment about it and the order of being have different offices. A real achievement and its later consequence do not depend on identifying reality with a digital machine.

[An achieved account remains answerable to its sources](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md); a correction can change what it warrants and how later accounting proceeds. Symbol carries the relation to source; Account makes that relation available for judgment; Trust entrusts the next act while keeping the return route active. Their conjunction lets an achieved form carry both its determining relations and its consequences.

The comparisons below distinguish qualitative succession, concrescence, biological production, formal self-reference and dynamical modelling. A claim can be developed in its own register and then make another register more exact. Their positive relation concerns formation and continuation. No common word for process substitutes for the transformation each account actually specifies.

## #1 — The next note changes the whole heard

In Bergson's [melody and clock analyses](../sources/process-systems-theory/bergson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson/bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson.md#bergson-1913-time-free-will-pogson-q001), conscious states permeate one another. A subsequent note changes the phrase heard, whereas a row of positions displays separable terms. Counted simultaneities differ from the synthesis through which a succession is retained. Lived qualitative development consequently has a different office from an elapsed-time counter.

A trace can preserve the order of events while omitting how a later event changes the significance of an earlier one. Correcting a source attribution changes what a previously persuasive argument means; it does more than add an item to an otherwise unchanged list. Interpretation occurs through [situated conditions](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md), whose [available distinctions and consequences](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C07-Conditions-of-Worldhood.md) make the correction matter for what can next be known or done.

The technical comparison concerns inherited conditions. A changed memory or context can alter later retrieval, evaluation or permitted action, and those changes can be inspected. The retained trace is known content; the agent reading and comparing it is its local functional knower; storage, retrieval and evaluation are its mediating operations. Within a person’s inquiry, that reading machinery itself belongs to the means through which the succession becomes available. Bergson’s qualitative continuity concerns the person’s lived synthesis through which a later note changes the phrase now heard. The record of positions, its interpreting agent and the containing act of inquiry have distinct offices. Their relation makes the comparison exact through what the inheritance changes.

<a id="bergson-whitehead-gebser-comparison"></a>
Bergson, Whitehead and Gebser have distinct temporal offices. Bergson describes lived qualitative continuity; Whitehead describes an occasion's achieved satisfaction and subsequent objective availability; [Gebser describes mutation and the diaphanous co-presence of consciousness structures](../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) through his selected passages. Taylor's conjunction makes return a transformed inheritance, not a reset to an earlier coordinate. An experienced succession, an occasion's becoming and a historical mutation remain different objects. For a runtime, a later cut can inherit conditions formed by earlier cuts, and its result can reach the relevant receiving condition through correction or fitting retention. A claim that processing changed requires an identified transformation and the subsequent act that inherited it. Selected *Time and Free Will* passages bear the qualitative-succession comparison, including melodic synthesis. Bergson's fuller theory of memory in *Matter and Memory*, or creative evolution in *Creative Evolution*, requires the respective work's own argument.

## #2 — A satisfaction becomes available beyond itself

In [Whitehead's Category of the Ultimate](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q001), received diversity becomes the unity of a novel actual occasion; the achieved occasion then belongs to the diversity available for further becoming. His one names singularity, expressly distinguished from the integral number. The account is not obtained merely by applying arithmetic to a collection.

Whitehead distinguishes [an entity's own becoming from its functioning in another's self-creation](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q002). [Perishing](../sources/process-systems-theory/whitehead/whitehead-1978-process-reality/whitehead-1978-process-reality.md#whitehead-1978-process-reality-q003) ends individual absoluteness while the achieved occasion remains objectively available. Availability for another occurrence does not mean that the first subject's immediacy continues unchanged.

[A durable contribution can become another participant's means](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality.md). A statement, decision or artifact alters the receiving conditions without reproducing its maker's whole interior. Its consequence may reach an account, its relation to other accounts, or the rule under which accounts circulate. Each participant can receive through its own determining means; their common field is not thereby one undifferentiated subject.

Completion makes a determinate result available for consequences which could not travel while the act remained undecided. Leaving everything perpetually undecided would remove the achieved form through which another act can proceed. The native requirement is that completion retain its derivation and revisability, so its local authority can be used without being promoted into possession of the whole.

Creativity has the office of an ultimate category in Whitehead's account, rather than another actual occasion installed above the occasions it explains. Formation can be real without making its categoreal condition a competing formed entity. The selected Category of the Ultimate passage establishes that particular office; Taylor's QL derivation has its own premises.

## #3 — Production and re-entry require different demonstrations

[Maturana and Varela describe biological self-production](../sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition.md#maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition-q001) through a network regenerating its components and boundary. [Coupling preserves participating identities](../sources/process-systems-theory/maturana/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition/maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition.md#maturana-varela-1980-autopoiesis-cognition-q002); an additional criterion is required before the composite is called autopoietic. Stafford Beer's social extension in his preface remains separately attributed.

This comparison makes the technical investigation specific. Identify what a system produces, which processes produce it, what sustains those processes and where its boundary is drawn. A software agent's ability to edit a file or call a tool establishes those operations when observed. It does not establish that the operative unity reproduces its own production network. Equally, a dependency on external infrastructure does not make its actual agency unreal. The required account identifies that dependency and its consequence instead of collapsing the two questions.

<a id="enacted-world-and-instituted-permission"></a>
Distinctions matter within a world maintained through activity. In the biological account, maintaining organization through perturbation supplies a norm internal to the continued living unity. A harness instead institutes permissions, goals, memory and resource conditions through which encounters can change its next act. Altering a tool permission changes what can be done; revising a source changes what can be warranted. Their institutional origin remains part of the explanation, even when the local context is recursively maintained.

The comparison therefore has a definite test: identify the norm, the boundary it helps sustain, the perturbation admitted and the loop through which the resulting distinction changes conduct or revises that norm. An allowed tool call and a living system’s continued production answer different questions. The native objective-internality claim keeps the constructed world’s real efficacy through its permissions, norms, resources and revisable conditions of action. Biological self-production requires the displayed network which regenerates its components and boundary; purpose or observed tool-use alone supplies a different account. A comparison through *The Embodied Mind* or *Mind in Life* must recover how each work connects cognition and world. The present biological criterion concerns constitutive production and coupling in the selected 1980 passages.

[Varela's 1975 calculus](../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q001) extends formal indication through an autonomous third state and specified reduction rules. His [later interpretations](../sources/process-systems-theory/varela/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference/varela-1975-calculus-self-reference.md#varela-1975-calculus-self-reference-q002) raise temporal and systemic questions. The construction is a determinate achievement under its rules; it supplies neither a general exemption from incompleteness nor an identity with biological organization.

In [computational self-return](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C43-Computational-Vimarsa.md), a determination reaches its relevant sources and conditions so that subsequent processing can change. A self-description alone does not establish this stronger claim: an identified change must be inherited by a later act. A corrected result under a fitting criterion, a changed world-model, a revised evaluator or commission, and reasoned retention have different offices in the general return. Comparing formal re-entry with native QL requires expressions and rules to be mapped explicitly: which transformations does each expression admit, and what do their results make available next?

## #4 — A recurrent pattern can change its jurisdiction

[Daza and colleagues define a dynamical basin](../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy.md#daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy-q001) through initial conditions leading a specified system to an attractor. Their [scope distinction](../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy.md#daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy-q002) separates the relevant dissipative setting from escape basins in open Hamiltonian systems. A literal model needs its variables, evolution and observable outcomes. A recurrent image has a different explanatory object.

In Frank's [Van Eenwyk encounter](../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md), formative archetypal dynamics, affectively organized complexes and symbolic transformation have distinct offices. A symbol can change the relation of interpreter and field rather than serving only as a static depiction. This positive authorial comparison is already developed; the notes' copied book passages still require independent verification.

Within [a local arbitration regime](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md), a criterion selects an image; affect weights attention and memory; a response produces further material received under that criterion. A contrary encounter can be converted into confirmation. Changing the criterion differs from collecting additional instances under it, while a fitting criterion can support correction or reasoned retention. The local organization remains a real capacity even when its jurisdiction has become excessive.

[A course becomes a frozen script](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C12-Script-Frozen-Conditioned-Will.md) when it conceals its conditions and admits every encounter only under its own authority. Repetition can be useful while those conditions remain revisable. Return restores access to formation, exclusions and counterfactual alternatives; ending the claim to necessity need not annihilate the acquired competence.

Frank's protected Van Eenwyk encounter extends this field through tools, skills, social relations and the material supply chain sustaining artificial and human activity. These relations belong to the actual conditions of a situated world. The proposed QL language addresses their transformations through its own native symmetry and return operations. Its philosophical office, empirical adequacy and implementation standing remain separately answerable.

<a id="dia-syn-dynamical-comparison"></a>
Dia-ballein and sym-ballein have different dynamical consequences. Dia-ballein generates genuinely differentiated trajectories; sym-ballein names recursive attraction and feedback through which differences compose a coherent pattern. Their native relation concerns differentiation and renewed composition. It neither calls every bifurcation the same symmetry-breaking event nor derives Taylor's `X/x` from a psychological author. A new branch and a changed relation among branches have different consequences.

A literal dynamical version is a proposed research construction. It must declare a state `z`, an evolution rule `F_λ`, a control parameter `λ`, an observation rule and the criterion for convergence before assigning a mathematical basin to an MEF lens. Changing a source, aperture or evaluator must be distinguished from another trajectory under an unchanged rule. The test would retain initial conditions, alternative lens runs and the resulting changes to selection and return; a recurrent verbal theme would not suffice as an observed attractor. The epistemic phase-space articulates possible inquiry. Its proposed basin model has the narrower, still-open task of making those variables, outcome classes and transformations measurable.

<a id="confinement-comparison-research"></a>
Physical confinement requires a mechanism as well as geometry. [The torus quotient and its two winding directions](../../matheme/topology/torus-cover-winding.md) distinguish closed from nonperiodic trajectories under their stated mathematical conditions. A comparison with tokamaks, stellarators, magnetic mirrors or inertial approaches must identify the confinement mechanism, operating regime, field/current source, transport, stability and exhaust conditions. Topology alone does not certify one approach as universally optimal.

The inductor, Earth-ring-current and vortex-ring leads raise distinct questions about what circulates, what maintains the field and what is idealised. An ITER numerical performance or stored-energy claim requires a dated machine/design witness. A proposed four-view comparison—identified square, lifted path, two-cycle torus and magnetic-field cross-section—crosses from geometry to engineering where physical mechanism and operating evidence become necessary. The older numerical or mission-status wording supplies no current verification. The native quotient and winding relations remain established independently of a finished physical comparison.

## #5→0 — A result changes the conditions of the next inquiry

Taylor's [moving-mirror image](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) gives [three motions](../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) distinct offices. A measure is exteriorised as a reflection; the produced image changes the field it later receives; the instrument then exposes its own source, angle and measure before requiring the person to conform, so the person can follow the relation back to its conditions. The proposed initiating vocation exceeds feedback alone. Computational self-return isolates the identified change inherited by subsequent processing; that mechanism remains within the whole image.

[A source relation made available to judgment can guide an entrusted next inquiry](../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD-symbol-account-and-trust.md). Bergson keeps qualitative succession distinct from its spatial record. Whitehead makes an achieved occasion available to further becoming. Biological production requires its constitutive network; formal self-reference requires its rules; a dynamical model requires its specified system; symbolic transformation requires its situated interpreter and consequence. A correction can reach an answer, task, world-model, evaluator or commission, while a fitting condition can be retained with reasons. The account of actual changed processing must additionally identify the change and the later act that inherited it.

[Bohm's enfoldment, dialogue and institutional encounter](bohm.md) have particular source histories within [a wider intellectual succession](../histories/traditions-and-disciplines/process-systems-science/HISTORY-process-systems-science.md). Neither chronology nor comparison alone establishes one genealogy of influence. Formation, inspection and continued action relate these different achievements, while each source can correct the particular relation through which another inquiry receives it.
